title: Could Ghost Return With Ramona in Power: Legacy?
htmlContent:
Ghost is one of the most famous deaths in TV drama, but a growing number of Power fans don't believe James St. Patrick is really gone. In a new breakdown video, YouTuber J Miles lays out one of the most detailed versions of the theory yet: that Ghost faked his death with help from political strategist Ramona Garrity, and that the two could resurface together now that Starz is moving forward with Power: Legacy.

It's a fan theory, not a confirmed storyline. Starz has not announced Omari Hardwick's return. But the case J Miles builds is getting attention as the franchise heads into its next chapter.

What We Actually Know About Power: Legacy

Starz announced Power: Legacy in June 2026 as the sixth series in the Power universe. Michael Rainey Jr. and Joseph Sikora return as Tariq St. Patrick and Uncle Tommy Egan, and the show is set to pick up after the events of Power Book IV: Force, with an eight-episode first season.

Separately, the prequel Power: Origins will follow a young Ghost and Tommy as they come up in New York. As of now, there has been no official word on Hardwick reprising Ghost in Legacy, though that hasn't slowed down the speculation.

J Miles points to the title itself as a clue. Force ended with Tariq showing up on Tommy, and the next show is literally called Legacy. "But whose legacy?" he asks.

Ghost Was Always 10 Steps Ahead

The theory starts with a simple idea: Ghost was too smart to get caught slipping in his own club. J Miles cites a line from the series finale where 2-Bit questions how someone like Dre could have pulled it off, a moment he says the show never followed up on.

He also points to a line from Power Book II: Ghost, when Zion says Ghost knew how to solve a problem before it became a problem. To J Miles, that's exactly what happened the night of the shooting: Ghost saw it coming and planned around it.

Why Ramona Is the Key

Ramona Garrity arrived in Power's final season as a Democratic Party political strategist. She was supposed to be working for Councilman Rashad Tate, but she ended up firmly in Ghost's corner.

J Miles argues Ramona was never a clean-cut politician. He highlights the scene where she says she's had guns pointed at her before, and the moment the missing money was suddenly returned to the books, something neither Ghost nor Tate appeared to know about. In his reading, Ramona was quietly protecting James long before they were together.

He also points to their conversation at the club the night of the shooting, when Ramona says they "still have to talk" and plans to meet Ghost back at his hotel. To J Miles, that wasn't romance. It was two people about to execute a plan.

The Missing Episode 16

The biggest pillar of the theory involves an episode count. J Miles plays a clip of Omari Hardwick on the All the Smoke podcast, where Hardwick refers to finishing the 16th episode of what he calls "season 6 and a half." Power's final season aired 15 episodes.

J Miles asks the question he says non-believers can't answer: if 16 episodes were shot, why did only 15 air? His answer is that the unseen episode showed Ghost alive with Ramona, and that it was shelved until behind-the-scenes contract issues were settled.

He adds that the series finale was titled "Exactly As We Planned," yet almost nothing went to plan for Tasha or Tariq that night. In his view, the only people whose plan worked perfectly were Ghost and Ramona.

Tariq, Kate and the Will

The theory doesn't stop with Ramona. J Miles believes Tariq knew part of the plan, possibly involving swapped bullets, but not the full ending, so his guilt in the interrogation room would look real. He compares it to other moments in the franchise where characters were kept in the dark so their reactions would sell.

He also points to Ghost's will in Power Book II, which arranged for Yasmine's adoption and sealed records, as proof of a man thinking unusually far ahead.

Ramona's Missing Closure

J Miles' final argument is that nearly every major character in Power got some kind of ending, except Ramona. Despite her ties to Ghost, Tate and the party, her name never came up across four seasons of Power Book II: Ghost. He believes that was intentional, because mentioning her would raise questions about James.

Will Ghost Actually Come Back?

For now, the answer remains unconfirmed. Hardwick has said in past interviews that he'd consider returning if the money and the story were right, which keeps the door open for fans. But Starz has only announced Tariq and Tommy for Legacy.

Whether Ghost walks back in alone, with Ramona or not at all, J Miles has given Power fans plenty to argue about before Legacy premieres.
excerpt: YouTuber J Miles has laid out one of the most detailed versions yet of the fan theory that Ghost faked his death with help from political strategist Ramona Garrity, and that the two could resurface together in Starz's upcoming Power: Legacy.
